conclusion: The Ur/Gadd route now improves object identity for two local rows (3898.1/U17649 and 3899.1/U8685), but it yields no external phonetic anchor. In the modeled Gadd/BM/Penn surface, Indus-inscribed objects lack readable cuneiform names/titles, while the cuneiform-inscribed BM 120573 lacks a recorded Indus sign sequence.
next_actions: Acquire Mitchell 1986 figures 106-117 to cross-check all local Ur row mappings against Gadd numbers and images.
Acquire Kjærum 1983 cat.279 and cat.319 for the Failaka row-level mapping problem.
Keep U17649 and U8685 as source-validated external-object controls, not phonetic anchors.
